verdict.rationale: Evidence shows an official CLI (npx skills) and an open specification/validator (SKILL.md format, skills-ref validate) that a developer could build against, but there is no dedicated language SDK (e.g., JS/Python client library) documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: an actual SDK package (npm/PyPI library) for programmatic integration, API reference docs beyond CLI flags, and independent developer usage of any such SDK.
